invoicePrinter.credentialsNotice: The password is shown only once. Enter it on the printer now.
invoicePrinter.description: Once set up, issued invoices are sent to the Epson thermal printer automatically and the printer reports whether they finished printing. Without a printer, invoices are printed from the browser. While the printer is offline, invoices are printed from the browser automatically.
invoicePrinter.label: Invoice printer
invoicePrinter.queued: Sent {count} unprinted invoices to the printer
invoicePrinter.removeConfirm: Invoices will be printed from the browser instead, and print jobs not yet sent will be cancelled. Remove the printer?
invoicePrinter.resetConfirm: The old password stops working immediately, and the printer can't print until you enter the new one. Reset the password?
invoicePrinter.steps: Enable Server Direct Print in the printer's Web Config and enter the ID, password and URL below. Invoice slips must be 5.7 cm wide, so use 58 mm paper. A shorter polling interval prints receipts sooner.

orderTicketPrinters.credentialsNotice: The password is shown only once. Enter it on the printer now.
orderTicketPrinters.description: Once an order is paid (cash received or online payment completed), order tickets print automatically: each item goes to the order ticket printer set on its menu section or item, and items without one go to the default printer. Refunding an item that already has a ticket prints a refund ticket on the printer that holds that ticket. When a print result is unknown, staff are asked to confirm it on the order.
orderTicketPrinters.label: Order ticket printers
orderTicketPrinters.removeConfirm: Tickets not yet sent to "{name}" will go to the printers their items now route to, and sections and items set to this printer will be unset. Remove the printer?
orderTicketPrinters.resetConfirm: The old password stops working immediately, and the printer can't print until you enter the new one. Reset the password?
orderTicketPrinters.setDefaultSuccess: Items without an order ticket printer will now print on "{name}"
orderTicketPrinters.steps: Enable Server Direct Print in the printer's Web Config and enter the ID, password and URL below. A shorter polling interval prints tickets sooner.

qrSecret.description: Only replace QR codes if they have leaked, for example if someone photographed one and posted it online. Replacing them immediately invalidates every printed table, counter, and drive-thru QR code, so download and put up new ones. Customers who already scanned will need to scan again.
qrSecret.label: Replace QR codes
qrSecret.restoreConfirm: QR codes printed before the last replacement will work again, and the current ones will stop working immediately. Restore the previous codes?
qrSecret.rotateConfirm: Every printed table, counter, and drive-thru QR code will stop working immediately. Download and put up the new ones; customers can't order by scanning until you do. If this was a mistake, you can restore the previous codes. Replace QR codes?
qrSecret.rotateSuccess: QR codes replaced. Download and put up the new ones.
